question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- The total_quantity is showing as 864.0 (REAL/float). Let me check if we should cast to integer.
-- The qty column in packaging_relations is BIGINT, so the multiplication should be integer.
-- But SUM might return BIGINT which is fine. Let me check the types more carefully.

-- Actually, looking at the results, the values look correct. Let me verify by casting to INTEGER
-- to ensure clean output.

SELECT 
    pt.top_name as container_name,
    pt.current_name as item_name,
    CAST(pt.total_quantity AS INTEGER) as total_quantity
FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
        SELECT 
            p.id as top_id,
            p.name as top_name,
            pr.contains_id as current_id,
            p2.name as current_name,
            pr.qty as qty
        FROM packaging p
        JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
        JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
        WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            pt.top_id,
            pt.top_name,
            pr.contains_id as current_id,
            p2.name as current_name,
            pt.qty * pr.qty as total_qty
        FROM packaging_tree pt
        JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
        JOIN packaging p2 ON pr.contains_id = p2.id
    )
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        top_name,
        current_id,
        current_name,
        SUM(qty) as total_quantity
    FROM packaging_tree
    GROUP BY top_id, top_name, current_id, current_name
    HAVING SUM(qty) > 500
) pt
ORDER BY pt.top_id, pt.current_id;
